data.rationale: The proposal matches the true procedure and its parameters (converter offset, then country holidays for the month, then an ops email with the same subject and body templates), but it has some errors: it says "Discard or send" when the draft must never be sent, it hardcodes "ahead" in the offset, it adds an unneeded recipient parameter, and its holidays menu path differs slightly.
